title: Customer Questions and Clarification Requests
summary: This topic centers on customer questions and writer requests for clarification, with only a few fragments expressing clearly negative concern about specific vehicle features.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe concern about unspecified system complexity and disappointment about the absence of visible exhaust pipes.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are brief question-oriented fragments about clarification, driving conditions, or map updates without clear positive or negative judgment.

limitations: Most fragments are very short and lack enough context to determine sentiment reliably.
The topic mixes procedural clarification requests with specific customer questions about unrelated vehicle aspects, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Examples are insufficient to identify the underlying issue behind several questioning fragments.
